answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by mandating each identity hold a unique physical pearl hardware token that generates an opal-signed proof of unique possession. The token nebula of serial numbers is cryptographically bound and manufacturer-limited; cloning or forging requires breaking the secure element, while acquiring many real tokens forces the attacker to purchase, ship, and maintain separate physical devices—incurring high per-identity capital and logistics costs that scale linearly with the attack size, whereas a single honest agent reuses one pearl indefinitely.
